GBP remains active with 195 total actions including 59 calls, providing a solid organic lead support layer.

performance.verdict: CPL efficiency is real, but spend contraction and 3 overdue milestones threaten August scoreboard.

findings.text: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) still open — leads arriving but source cannot be traced to calls or patients.
Sync + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) overdue — 83 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments in GHL; pipeline data unreliable.
Renewal closed 2026-07-23 at $2,200 — prove-it month requires leads-to-patients scoreboard, no tracking dashboard delivered yet.

CPL improved 25.99% to $11.90 but spend collapsed to $40.84/day — efficiency gain is budget-cut artefact, not true signal; 3-day spend (Aug 15–17: $18.51, $41.10, $34.86) runs well below the 45-day average of ~$54/day.
GBP actions hit 25 on Aug 14 then dropped to 0 for 3 consecutive days (Aug 15–17), organic support layer stalling at a critical prove-it moment.

suggestions.text: Close phone-match attribution gap immediately — without it, leads cannot be traced to booked patients on the August scoreboard.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution task was due 2026-08-07 and remains open. Without this fix, the 122 leads recorded over 28 days cannot be matched to GBP calls (59 calls) or OpenDental appointments, making the client's own scoreboard (leads → schedule → show → patient) unmeasurable. Success check: attribution source is populated on 100% of new contacts in GHL by 2026-08-21. Sohib to confirm with Ahmed/Ali that the fix is live and audited.

suggestions.text: Complete GHL sync + contact cleanup — 83 opps, 0 won, 0 appointments signals intake data is still broken, not leads.
suggestions.monday_update: Sync + contact cleanup was due 2026-08-14 and is overdue. GHL shows 83 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in the 28-day window, which almost certainly reflects missing or broken intake data rather than true zero conversions. Success check: at least 1 appointment record visible in GHL that matches an OpenDental entry by 2026-08-22, and the leads-to-patients dashboard is in draft form for Sohib review. This is a direct prove-it blocker.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta spend recovery to ~$54/day average for 3 days before any scale decision; CPL at $11.90 is promising but unconfirmed at full budget.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend dropped to a 3-day average of ~$31.49/day (Aug 15–17: $18.51, $41.10, $34.86) versus the 45-day series average of ~$54/day. The CPL improvement to $11.90 is likely an artefact of lower spend, not structural efficiency. Re-check on 2026-08-21: if spend has returned to ≥$50/day for 3 consecutive days and CPL holds at or below $11.90, a +15–20% budget increase on 'BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness' is defensible.
